transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because... I just can't stop seeing this rough, sunken-looking patch on my face. Every time I look in the mirror, or if I see a picture of myself, it's all I can focus on. It just makes one side of me look really old and beat-up. People keep telling me they barely notice anything, but... I don't know. It's really bothering me, so I figured I should come in.
Do you believe for certain that there is a serious defect in your face?

Well... I don't know if I'd say I know for certain. I mean, I look in the mirror and I see it right there, and it looks pretty bad to me. But then my wife or the guys at the site tell me I'm crazy and they don't see what I'm talking about. So... I'm not really sure what to think anymore. I just know what I see when I look at myself, even if other people say it isn't a big deal.
Do you find yourself repeatedly checking that area of your face in mirrors or other reflective surfaces?

Yeah, I do. A lot, actually. Especially before I head out to work, or... like if I'm going over to my sister's for game night. I'll just stand in the bathroom and keep checking the mirror. I turn my face around, trying to see it under the different lights, you know? And I catch myself rubbing at the spot, too. 

If it looks really bad to me... well, I'll pull my hat down real low to try and hide it. Or sometimes I just make up an excuse not to go out at all, if I think it's just too obvious.
